newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr edges up vs yen but stays top-heavy in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dlr edges up vs yen but stays top-heavy in Tokyo.

text.p: *Dollar inches up against yen in morning Tokyo on purchases from Japanese operators, probably investment trust management firms, with other steady bids detected near and below 126 yen.
*But topside remains heavy near 126.50 yen amid lingering caution about possible dollar-selling intervention by Bank of Japan.
*"Japanese operators, including investors, are nervous on the topside amid intervention fears," a bank dealer said.
*But a city bank dealer said: "Japanese traders started buying dollars in morning Tokyo after seeing the dollar/yen rate come back above 126 yen from New York trade."

*Amid lack of fresh factors in morning, traders await remarks by Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of Ministry of Finance's International Finance Bureau, at gathering of foreign exchange dealers in Tokyo at 6.30 p.m. (0930 GMT), dealers said.
*"I think traders expect Sakakibara will not say anything that could lead to a weaker yen," said a city bank dealer.
